notes.title: SAO Utils 2 is Now Free to Play
notes.content:
SAO Players,
Thank you all the love and support to this project.
SAO Utils 2: Progressive is now open to public since 6 November, 2022.
Anyone can Free to Play on Steam or download from sao.gpbeta.com without any limitations.

[h1]NERvGear Core System / 1.2.1[/h1]
[list]
[*] Add User Manual
[*] Add widget group identity
[*] Fix some graphics issues in launcher
[*] Fix window title height with different DPI
[*] Improve crash handling for some issues
[*] Minor resources adjustment
[*] Data Picker: Add value mode highlight
[*] Web Browser: Add pop-up SFX
[*] Launcher Menu: Remove the unnecessary Exit button
[*] Launcher Menu: Improve extension suffix
[*] Startup Animation: Fix crash on finished
[/list]

[h1]HUD Widget Extension / 1.0.3[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix a typo
[/list]

[h1]Media Support Extension / 1.2.1[/h1]
[list]
[*] Kugou Music: Fix cannot fetch data from new version
[/list]

[h1]Mail Box Extension / 1.0.2[/h1]
[list]
[*] Inbox: Fix incorrect date
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42018057/a04a6dcaba2c57875b88cbe2e68d3d10cee12d3d.png[/img]

[quote=GPBeta]I'm sure you've already noticed that the logout button is missing from the main menu.
But this is not a defect in the software.
I repeat...
This is not a defect in the software. It is a feature of SAO Utils.

Right now, you're probably wondering, "why".  Why would GPBeta, developer of SAO Utils, do all this?  
My goal has already been achieved. 
I created SAO Utils for one reason.  To create this world and intervene in it.
And now, it is complete.
[/quote]
However, I believe that players who have carefully read the tutorial must know how to get it back.
This ends the tutorial for the official SAO Utils Launch.  

Good luck, players.
Studio GPBeta

notes.title: SAO Utils 2 is now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Thanks to all Beta Testers, SAO Utils 2 is available in Early Access now!
But it doesn't mean to the end of our development. Besides the regular updates for bug fix, we are going to add more cool and useful staffs according to the players' feedback.

[h2]How Can I Early Access SAO Utils 2 Now?[/h2]

SAO Utils 2: Progressive will be unlocked for everyone who owns SAO Utils: Beta automatically, newly purchased customers are not excepted, please find out this new app in your Steam library and enjoy our new SAO Utils world!
Don't forget to check out the new Workshop, we have prepared many useful and cool staffs for you.
Also don't get surprised that SAO Utils 2 will record playtime for BOTH Beta and Progressive versions on Steam.

[h2]When Will The Early Access End And Free to Play?[/h2]

SAO Utils 2: Progressive will come to Full Release and Free to Play on 5 Nov, 2022.

[h2]Are There Any Bonuses for Beta Testers?[/h2]

Both Early Access and Free to Play versions will not have any functionality limitation, but the Workshop and some Steam features are reserved for the users whom owned SAO Utils: Beta.

[h2]Where Can I Find The User Manual or Tutorial?[/h2]
Sorry, it's not available at the moment, so... have fun discovering it :P

Thank you for all your support!
Studio GPBeta
